definitions.explanation: A traffic incident where a driver strikes a person or vehicle and flees the scene without stopping to help or identify themselves.

examples.japanese: ひき{逃|に}げ{事故|じこ}があった。
ひき{逃|に}げの{犯人|はんにん}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}の{情報|じょうほう}のおかげで、ひき{逃|に}げの{車|くるま}が{特定|とくてい}された。
examples.english: Thanks to witness information, the hit-and-run vehicle was identified.

notes:
FORMATION:
ひき ({轢|ひ}き, from {轢|ひ}く "to run over") + {逃|に}げ (from {逃|に}げる "to flee"). Literally "run over and flee."

LEGAL CONTEXT:
ひき{逃|に}げ is a serious crime in Japan. Penalties are more severe than for accidents where the driver remains at the scene. It is also called {救護|きゅうご}{義務|ぎむ}{違反|いはん} (failure to fulfill the duty to assist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひき{逃|に}げ{事故|じこ}: hit-and-run accident
- ひき{逃|に}げ{犯|はん}: hit-and-run offender
- ひき{逃|に}げにあう: to be the victim of a hit-and-run
